Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.s1Body: René Rasmussen is the data controller for PoGoSundet. Contact: renraz@gmail.com
Privacy.s2Body: We collect the information you provide when creating an account and profile:
Privacy.s2List: Email address · Trainer name (in-game name) · Pokémon GO friend code · First name (optional) · Mini bio (optional) · Profile photo (optional)
Privacy.s3Title: 3. How do we use the data?
Privacy.s3Body: Your data is used solely to operate PoGoSundet: to show your profile to other local players and make it easy to add each other as friends in Pokémon GO.
Privacy.s4Body: Processing is based on your consent, given at registration (GDPR Article 6(1)(a)).
Privacy.s5Body: Your data is stored for as long as your account is active. You can delete your account at any time via "Edit profile" in the app — all your data is deleted immediately and permanently.
Privacy.s6Body: We do not sell, rent, or share your personal data with third parties. Your profile information (trainer name, friend code, first name, bio) is visible to other registered users of PoGoSundet. You can hide your friend code under "Edit profile" — it is then neither shown to nor shared with other users.
Privacy.s7Body: We use Supabase (EU/Ireland) for data storage and authentication. Supabase acts as a data processor on our behalf and is contractually obligated to comply with GDPR. For error logging we use Sentry (EU region) to detect and fix technical faults in the app. Sentry only receives technical error information; we do not deliberately collect your IP address or other personal data via the error log. If you consent to analytics (see section 9), we also use Amplitude (EU region) for anonymous usage statistics. If you report a bug via the app, your report is stored in our private issue tracker on GitHub, which thereby acts as a data processor for the report text and your trainer name — the report contains only what you write yourself, plus your trainer name. All processors handle data solely on our behalf and in compliance with GDPR.
Privacy.s8Body: You have the right to access your data, rectification of inaccurate data, erasure ("right to be forgotten"), data portability, and the right to lodge a complaint with your supervisory authority. Contact us at renraz@gmail.com to exercise these rights.
Privacy.s9Body: PoGoSundet uses technically necessary cookies to keep you logged in. We do not use marketing cookies. With your explicit consent, we use Amplitude (EU region) for anonymous usage statistics so we can see which features are used and improve the app. The statistics are fully anonymous: we do not send your name, email, user ID, IP address, search terms, or the content of your messages. Statistics are only collected if you actively tap "Accept" in the consent banner — if you tap "Decline", Amplitude is never loaded. You can withdraw your consent at any time by clearing the app's data (cookies/storage) in your browser, after which you will be asked again. If you choose to see nearby gyms when posting a raid, the app asks for permission to use your device's location. The location is used only in your browser to sort the gym suggestions by distance — it is never stored and never sent to our servers.
Privacy.s10Body: Questions about this privacy policy can be sent to renraz@gmail.com
Privacy.s11Body: If you choose to receive push notifications, we store your browser's push subscription (endpoint and encryption keys) in our database. This data is used solely to notify you of new raids, of new messages in raid chats you've joined, of new direct messages sent to you, and when a new player joins a raid you're attending. A direct-message or raid-chat-message notification contains only the sender's name (and, for raid chats, the raid's boss or gym — already visible in the app) — never the message content itself. A new-participant notification contains only the player's trainer name, which is already visible in the app. You can unsubscribe at any time via your browser or device settings — the subscription is deleted automatically.
Privacy.s12Body: When you post in the shared channels (#generelt and #app-feedback), we store your message together with your user id and timestamp. Messages are visible to all signed-in users of PoGoSundet and are kept indefinitely. When you delete your account, all your chat messages are deleted automatically along with your profile.
Privacy.s14Body: If you report a message, we store a copy of the reported message, your trainer name as the reporter, the sender's trainer name, the reason you select, and any comment you add. The copy is kept because the report would otherwise be useless once the message is deleted. Reports can only be read by the app administrator — not by other users. If you report a private message, only that single reported message is shared with the administrator, never the rest of the conversation. The administrator can delete the reported message, message you or the sender, and ban an account from posting. If your account is banned we store the time and a reason, which is shown to you. Reports and bans are kept while your account is active and are deleted along with the account.
Privacy.s15Body: If you choose to share your location, we store your coordinates, how long the share lasts, and any note you write yourself. Sharing only happens when you actively start it, and all logged-in members can see where you are while it is active. You choose the duration — 2 hours at most — and you can stop sharing at any time. Your location is deleted automatically when the time is up: we only keep your most recent position, never a history of where you have been. We store one row per user, overwritten each time your position updates. Your location only updates while you have the app open — a web app cannot read location in the background — so others may see where you were a few minutes ago, not where you are right now. We recommend that you do not share your location from home. The map loads tiles from OpenStreetMap, which can therefore see which area you are looking at. Tapping "Vis på kort" opens Google Maps with the selected coordinates — that only happens when you tap it yourself.

Terms.title: Terms of Use
Terms.s1Body: PoGoSundet is a free, non-commercial platform for the local Pokémon GO community in Frederikssund. The app is made by René Rasmussen as a spare-time project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Niantic, The Pokémon Company, or Nintendo.
Terms.s2Body: By creating an account on PoGoSundet, you accept these terms as well as our privacy policy. If you do not accept the terms, you cannot create an account or use the app.
Terms.s3Body: You must provide accurate information when creating your profile, and you may only create one account per person. You are responsible for keeping your password confidential and for everything that happens on your account.
Terms.s4Body: You may not use PoGoSundet to harass, threaten, or impersonate others, share illegal content, spam, or otherwise harm other users or the service. Messages in shared channels, raid chat, and direct messages must follow ordinary good conduct.
Terms.s5Body: You own the content you share in the app — e.g. profile photo, bio, raid photos, and messages. By sharing content, you grant PoGoSundet the right to display it to other users as part of the service. You are responsible for what you share and must hold the rights to it (e.g. your own raid screenshots).
Terms.s6Body: Other users can report messages that violate these terms. We may delete violating content, send a warning, or ban an account from posting if the terms are violated repeatedly or seriously. See the privacy policy's section on reports and moderation for how this is handled.
Terms.s7Body: You can delete your account at any time via "Edit profile" in the app. We may terminate or restrict your access to the app if you violate these terms.
Terms.s8Body: PoGoSundet is provided as is, without warranty of uptime, error-free operation, or that any given feature will always be available. We are not liable for losses or damages arising from use of the app, to the extent permitted under Danish law.
Terms.s9Body: We may update these terms from time to time. Material changes will be marked with a new "Last updated" date at the top of this page. Continued use of the app after a change means you accept the updated terms.
Terms.s10Body: These terms are governed by Danish law. Questions about the terms can be sent to renraz@gmail.com

Onboarding.title: Welcome to PoGoSundet
Onboarding.intro: Two steps and you're ready. Install the app on your phone, and learn to add friends in seconds with QR codes straight from Pokémon GO.
Onboarding.step1Lead: PoGoSundet is a web app — you install it straight from the browser. No App Store, no download.
Onboarding.android2: Tap the ⋮ menu in the top right.
Onboarding.android4: Confirm — the icon is now on your home screen.
Onboarding.ios2: Tap the Share button at the bottom of the screen.
Onboarding.installNote: Web apps install only from Safari on iOS and Chrome on Android. Other browsers don't show the install option.
Onboarding.step2Title: Add friends with QR — straight from Pokémon GO
Onboarding.step2Lead: On the computer you open a player's code. On the phone you scan it in Pokémon GO — and you're friends in seconds.
Onboarding.qrStep1Title: Start a scan session on the computer
Onboarding.qrStep1Body: Go to Players and pick the trainers you want to add.
Onboarding.qrStep2Title: Open Pokémon GO on your phone
Onboarding.qrStep2Body: Grab your phone — the computer keeps the QR code ready.
Onboarding.qrStep3Title: Find the QR scanner in the game
Onboarding.qrStep3Body: Go to Friends → Add Friend → QR CODE.
Onboarding.qrStep4Title: Scan the code from the screen
Onboarding.qrStep4Body: Hold your phone up to the screen until the code is captured.
Onboarding.qrStep5Body: The computer jumps to the next person in the list.
Onboarding.tip: Tip: At a local meetup you can gather around the screen and add the whole list in a few minutes.
Onboarding.panelHint: Open Pokémon GO → Friends → Add Friend → QR CODE and scan
